text: The model labeled the applicant as low‑risk because three key signals pulled the default probability down. First, the revolving‑credit utilization is only about 0.5 % of the available limit (0.0046), which strongly lowers risk – the model gave this factor a –0.65 contribution. Second, the applicant is 69 years old; older borrowers in this data set tend to default less, adding a –0.33 reduction. Finally, the record shows zero instances of payments that were 30‑59 days late, which further cuts risk by –0.15. Together, these three negative contributions outweigh any other influences, resulting in a relatively low overall default probability of 10.8 % and a “low risk” decision.
